elements.text: Heavy engineering, mining services and equipment hire, run from one base at Kurri Kurri in the NSW Hunter Valley.
Investor update · Prepared for holders of ALFABS Australia Limited ordinary shares

slots.title: The three divisions
slots.col.1.heading: Engineering and fabrication
slots.col.1.body: Heavy steel fabrication, machining and maintenance, delivered from the Kurri Kurri workshop and on customer sites.
slots.col.2.heading: Mining services
slots.col.2.body: Crews and supervision supplied to mine sites for maintenance, shutdown and production support work.
slots.col.3.heading: Equipment hire
slots.col.3.body: An owned plant and equipment fleet hired to mining, industrial and construction customers.

slots.title: FY26 operating highlights
slots.lead: All three divisions traded through the year from the single Kurri Kurri base.
bullets: Engineering and fabrication remained the anchor division, working from the Kurri Kurri workshop.
Mining services crews stayed deployed on customer sites across the period.
The hire fleet continued to earn on both the company's own contracts and third-party hire.
Certification and safety obligations were maintained across every division.

slots.title: The Kurri Kurri facility and fleet
slots.left.heading: The workshop
slots.left.body: Kurri Kurri holds the fabrication, machining and maintenance capability, and is the base from which crews and equipment are dispatched to customer sites.
slots.right.heading: The fleet
slots.right.body: Owned plant and equipment is deployed on the company's own contracts and hired out to third parties, so the same asset base earns across two divisions.

slots.statement: Every division works to third-party certified management systems.
support: Quality, environmental and work health and safety management systems are certified and externally audited.
Access to customer sites depends on holding those certifications and on the safety record behind them.

slots.title: Financial position
slots.point.1.heading: Revenue base
slots.point.1.body: Earnings come from three divisions serving overlapping customers, so no single contract carries a whole revenue line.
slots.point.2.heading: Asset backing
slots.point.2.body: The Kurri Kurri facility and the hire fleet are owned operating assets sitting behind the balance sheet.
slots.point.3.heading: Reporting
slots.point.3.body: Statutory results are prepared under Australian Accounting Standards and lodged with the ASX.

slots.title: Capital and outlook
slots.delivered.heading: Established
delivered: Listed on the ASX under the code AAL.
Three operating divisions run from a single Kurri Kurri base.
An owned facility and hire fleet supporting all three divisions.
slots.next.heading: Focus ahead
next: Keep the hire fleet utilised across own work and third-party hire.
Maintain the certifications that give crews access to customer sites.
Grow the divisions from the existing base rather than duplicating it.
